I will structure the team to separate the "market research" (prices/incentives/efficiency) from the "technical infrastructure" (charging) and the "financial modeling" (TCO calculation), with a dedicated auditor to ensure the citations and dates are precise before the final memo is drafted. R10: State every assumption.
R11: Cite every figure with its date.
R12: Give a recommendation.

- given: 20 Class 8 tractors.
- given: Regional routes < 250 miles/day.
- given: 60,000 miles per truck per year.
